mathematical_scope: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal edge cut and cycle projections on real unweighted binary cubes augmented by the antipodal perfect matching; integer dimensions at least five.
scientific_integrity: A finite Walsh/beta-integral proof establishes the unlimited dimension statement. Finite exact-rational character and graph-Laplacian checks are corroboration only. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not determine minimum norms of arbitrary projections, weighted variants, or intermediate exponent operator norms. Literature searches do not constitute an exhaustive novelty guarantee.
title: Central-binomial endpoint projection norms on antipodally augmented hypercubes
